name: DropshippingLeads MCP
description: Query a public snapshot of small online retailers by keyword, category and recorded sales-market label for merchant research. Free access covers 14 categories with 100 records per category, excluding food and beverages; no service API key is required. Four tools provide coverage, merchant search, merchant details and methodology. Queries do not run live searches or crawling. Framework code uses MIT; actual data follows separate Free Data Terms v1.0 for internal research, retention and private AI analysis, without resale or public redistribution.
